usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and HelloLeads CRM holds leads, so “Order Cancelled” can create a lead through “Create Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Lead” in HelloLeads CRM
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order is a customer worth a follow-up, and the action puts them in the CRM as a lead.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so a lead made from it appears after a scheduled check.
